name: abap2UI5-samples
description: Learn how to code with abap2UI5.

scripts.syfixes: find . -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.downport: rm -rf src/00/97 src/00/98 && abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc && npm run syfixes && node scripts/generate-samples-md.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:cloud && npm run check:abap2ui5 && npm run check:chains && npm run check:agents && npm run check:strip && npm run check:keywords && npm run check:launchpad && npm run check:prose && npm run check:docs-links && npm run check:app-rules && npm run rename
